UML Activity Diagram: File Deletion & Recovery Workflow
Manages deletion requests: confirmation gate, OS Recycle Bin dispatch, SQLite soft-delete, exit animation, and atomic rollback on failure

Triggered via 3D context menu, hotkey, or multi-select

Display Deletion Confirmation Gate
Show target path(s), count & destination: OS Trash

User Confirmed
Action?

Abort Deletion Operation
Dismiss dialogue & retain 3D active state

Begin SQLite Transaction & Snapshot State
Record previous spatial placement in recovery buffer

Invoke ITrashService (OS Native Trash)
Move file to Recycle Bin (Win) / Trash (macOS / Linux)

OS Trash
Succeeded?

Rollback SQLite Transaction
Revert changes; restore file placement record

Display Error Alert Dialogue
Show OS error (Permission Denied, File Locked, etc.)

Restore 3D Visual Mesh State
Reset node transform and remove loading indicators

Update SQLite: Mark Deleted / Remove Anchor
Set state = 'DELETED' & record deletion timestamp
